stories.summary: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims to have discovered a proof of the Riemann hypothesis using Claude. The conjecture, which dates to 1859, carries a $1 million prize from the Clay Mathematics Institute. The proof has not yet been peer reviewed, and nobody can read it yet.

Google Gemini adds GIF generation
stories.summary: Google Gemini can now generate animated GIFs from text prompts, photos, or videos. The feature uses the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model to create loops. Users can now skip the process of searching through existing GIF libraries to find a reaction.

stories.title: AI agents move into text messaging
stories.summary: A growing number of AI agents can now be messaged like a person to schedule appointments, research trips, or manage calendars. Instinct, which recently reached a $10 billion valuation, is among the services competing to handle tasks directly within a user's existing text messaging app.

stories.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for rapid execution
stories.summary: Google has announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an AI model adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon. Google claims Hydrogen surpasses its frontier Gemini 4 Argon model during default tasks. The model is intended for rapid execution of agentic workflows like writing code and running tests.

stories.title: Google rolls out Create My Widget for Pixel phones
stories.summary: Google has released its Create My Widget feature for Pixel 10 and 11 series devices. The tool allows users to generate custom home screen widgets using Gemini Intelligence. The feature is currently unavailable on the Pixel 10a, as it requires a device compatible with Gemini Intelligence.

stories.title: Google highlights community projects for Gemini 4 Carbon
stories.summary: Google is promoting the capabilities of its Gemini 4 Carbon model, citing its performance in deep reasoning and extended verification. The company suggests the model could provide a competitive edge for small businesses. Developers are currently using the tool to explore various real-world applications.

stories.title: Gemini for Mac gains computer control
stories.summary: The Gemini app for Mac can now open apps and click through tasks on behalf of users. The feature is currently limited to English in the US and requires a paid subscription. Users must be running macOS Sequoia 15 or later on Apple silicon hardware.

stories.title: AI tools tested for subscription tracking
stories.summary: A user attempted to build a subscription tracker app using both Google Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. The experiment aimed to monitor monthly and yearly spending without downloading third-party software. Only one of the two models successfully produced a functional application for the user's Android home screen.

stories.title: OpenAI updates prompting guidance for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.summary: OpenAI has released new prompt templates for its GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models to discourage brief answers and unnecessary questions. The company advises developers to instruct models to make assumptions rather than interrupting workflows. Parameters like temperature and top_p are no longer available in the API.

stories.title: Google to retire Nest app and replace Assistant with Gemini
stories.summary: Google will retire the Nest app on January 25, 2027, and replace Google Assistant with Gemini for Home on its smart devices. Users will be required to transition to the Google Home app for device management. The company says existing hardware will remain functional after the switch.

stories.title: India opens first dedicated AI and quantum university campus
stories.summary: The National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology has inaugurated a transit campus in Andhra Pradesh for India’s first AI and quantum computing university. The project is backed by a Rs 730.70 crore central government grant from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.

stories.title: Google commits $5 million to IIT Kharagpur for AI research
stories.summary: Google has pledged $5 million to IIT Kharagpur to support research in Indic languages, agriculture, and materials science. The funding, announced during the institute's 75th anniversary, aims to strengthen India’s technical talent pool and infrastructure. The investment carries personal significance for CEO Sundar Pichai, an alumnus of the school.

stories.title: Banks struggle to keep pace with AI-powered cyber threats
stories.summary: Cybersecurity experts warn that AI tools are allowing hackers to identify software vulnerabilities faster than financial institutions can patch them. The shift is particularly concerning for banks relying on older technology infrastructure, as attackers increasingly exploit weaknesses that were previously unknown to security teams.

stories.title: IIT Patna receives new AI centre and research park
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated a centre of excellence in AI at IIT Patna. The campus will also host a Rs 400-crore research park, funded by the Bihar government and the Higher Education Financing Agency, to provide space for startups and MSMEs to test prototypes.

stories.title: India’s first AI, Quantum University campus inaugurated in Guntur of Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: The National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology (NIELIT) transit campus was inaugurated at the Centre for Distance Education (CDE) building on the premises of Acharya Nagarjuna University (ANU) near Guntur on Saturday, making it India's first Artificial Intelligence and Quantum University campus. Inaugurating the campus, Economic Advisor to the

stories.summary: Technology giant Google on Saturday said it will provide IIT Kharagpur with USD 5 million, about Rs 46 crore, to develop and accelerate advanced AI research. stories.title: Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in record-breaking IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic has completed the largest IPO on record, raising $81.3 billion at a valuation of $1.5 trillion. The company priced its shares at $83, exceeding its initial target range. Meanwhile, Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion as mega-rounds continue to land across the AI sector.

stories.title: Unsiloed AI raises $7.5 million in seed funding
stories.summary: San Francisco-based startup Unsiloed AI has raised $7.5 million in a seed round led by Felicis. Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni, the company builds software to convert complex documents into structured data for AI agents. The startup plans to use the capital to expand its engineering team.

stories.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
stories.summary: Startup investor Ben Narasin is so jazzed about Anthropic's blockbuster IPO that he's planning a party later this month at his Silicon Valley home. Sake, vodka and Krug Champagne will be served. Each attendee will be given two jars of caviar. "This is a celebration of the most material, significant,

stories.title: Sarvam's Token Factory Raises India's AI Inference Stakes
stories.summary: Sarvam AI's latest announcement of its Token Factory has brought a new layer of India's artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure ecosystem into focus. The Bengaluru-based startup on November 16 launched a commercial platform that allows developers and enterprises to access multiple AI models through its computing infrastructure. The launch comes as

stories.title: August AI raises $12 million to automate healthcare tasks
stories.summary: Healthtech startup August AI has raised $12 million from Accel and Peak XV Partners. The company has launched an AI agent designed to handle phone calls to doctors and insurers on behalf of patients. The funding will support efforts to navigate the US healthcare system.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO: Indian Investors Join The Frenzy
stories.summary: For many Indian investors, it was the first chance to own a leading AI model company directly. Indian investors have shown a strong appetite for Anthropic's blockbuster initial public offering (IPO). The artificial intelligence company emerged as one of the most actively traded US stocks on Indian investment platforms on

stories.title: AI may not work like the human brain after all
stories.summary: Researchers at York University discovered that AI models predicting brain activity often rely on internal processes the human brain does not use. The study suggests that AI may be less similar to human cognition than previously assumed, complicating its reliability in neuroscience research.

stories.title: OpenAI tightens defenses against internal reasoning extraction
stories.summary: OpenAI has updated safeguards for its GPT-6.2 models to prevent the extraction of internal reasoning. The company reports that success rates for attacks pulling protected reasoning from requests dropped from 54.0 percent on earlier versions to 0.2 percent on the latest iteration.

stories.title: Researchers introduce physics-based constraints for AI models
stories.summary: MIT researchers have developed a method to apply physics-based restrictions to machine learning models of chaotic systems. The approach aims to prevent models from drifting into physically impossible predictions, ensuring that simulations of weather and climate patterns remain within realistic bounds.

stories.title: RadixArk releases DaisyRose-27B coding model
stories.summary: RadixArk has launched DaisyRose-27B, an open-weight agentic coding model trained using reinforcement learning without supervised fine-tuning. The model, which replaces the Qwen3.8-27B base, reportedly improves performance on Terminal Bench 4.1 from 5.6 to 12.0 pass@1. It requires one GPU to run.

Nvidia faces internal and external pressure
stories.summary: Nvidia reported soaring revenue this week, even as some tech executives publicly circulated a petition calling for the return of former CEO Jensen Huang. The company maintains that it has no plans for such a leadership change.

stories.title: Cotton accuses Lutnick of ignoring alerts on AI chip smuggling to China - NewsNation
Marvell stock drops 22 percent in one week
stories.summary: Marvell Technology shares fell 22 percent over the past week amid broader volatility in AI chip stocks. The company reported no negative news of its own, though its pending acquisition of Lumentum has linked the performance of the two stocks.

stories.title: Retail investors eye AI chip stocks after selloff
stories.summary: Following a decline in Nvidia shares, retail investors are evaluating other companies in the semiconductor sector. Analysts suggest that recent market pullbacks may offer opportunities in solid businesses that have moved from crowded to ignored status.

stories.title: Trump proposes tax on overseas data centers
stories.summary: President Trump stated he is considering a tax on U.S. companies that build data centers in other countries. The president, who has not yet discussed the proposal with his cabinet, suggested the industry is making enough profit to justify the potential levy.

stories.title: Treasury says no new Nvidia export restrictions needed
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that no further restrictions on the sale of older Nvidia chips to China are required. The administration previously moved to block China's remote access to the latest semiconductors, but officials believe current measures are sufficient.

stories.title: Rapidus faces production challenges on 2nm node
stories.summary: Rapidus may miss its 2027 mass production target as it struggles to produce functioning SRAM cells on its 2nm-class node. The company reportedly missed a critical milestone this summer and is currently addressing contamination issues at its fabrication facility.

stories.title: SpaceX secures billions in GPU financing
stories.summary: Apollo Global Management and Goldman Sachs have priced $44 billion in debt to fund Nvidia chip purchases for SpaceX. The deal, described as the largest GPU financing to date, saw strong investor demand that exceeded the company's initial plans.

stories.title: Nvidia faces potential pricing pressure
stories.summary: Nvidia may face margin pressure as AI models become easier to move between different chip architectures. Anthropic stated it can switch models to alternative hardware in days, potentially weakening the competitive barrier that has historically helped Nvidia retain its customer base.

stories.title: PM Modi says AI will not replace skilled workers
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that artificial intelligence will not threaten the livelihoods of skilled workers. Speaking at a convocation in Lucknow, he argued that vocational skills and traditional craftsmanship will command increasing respect in the global job market.

stories.title: New Layoff Data Show Job Cuts Down 41% So Far This Year - WSJ
PM Modi emphasizes value of traditional skills
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that AI cannot replace individuals who possess practical skills. Addressing a ceremony in Lucknow, he claimed that historical invaders targeted India's traditional craftsmanship, but the country is now moving toward becoming a global hub for skilled labor.

stories.title: PM Modi highlights demand for vocational training
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that skilled workers will be increasingly valued over university graduates as AI reshapes the economy. He cited a global need for vocational expertise, including ITI-trained professionals, as a key factor in India's future workforce strategy.

stories.title: PM Modi says skills remain relevant despite AI
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that skilled workers will retain livelihood opportunities despite concerns over AI job displacement. Addressing a skill convocation in Lucknow, he asserted that individuals possessing practical skills would command greater respect than those holding only academic certificates. India is currently aiming to become a global skill

stories.title: Microsoft CEO links 60,000 buyouts to AI
stories.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella confirmed that the company's recent offer of voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees was driven by its AI transition. Speaking at the DealBook Summit, Nadella described the reorganization as a necessary step for the company to adapt to the ongoing shift toward artificial intelligence.

stories.title: India, China and Nigeria lead global workplace AI adoption
stories.summary: A 2025 study by the University of Melbourne and KPMG found that 91 percent of surveyed employees in India use AI at work, followed by China at 88 percent and Nigeria at 85 percent. Workers are using the technology for tasks ranging from information retrieval to data processing.

stories.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to 27 percent of workforce
stories.summary: Microsoft has offered voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees, representing 27 percent of its global staff. CEO Satya Nadella stated the program is a direct result of the company's AI transition, which he claims is fundamentally reshaping roles. The software giant is currently retooling its entire organization.

stories.title: UPSC chairman discusses AI in Indian education
stories.summary: Dr. Ajay Kumar, chairman of the Union Public Service Commission, noted that AI is rapidly altering workplace requirements and institutional learning. In an interview with ETEducation, he emphasized the need for India to strengthen its data infrastructure and research capabilities to emerge as a global AI leader.

stories.title: Ten nations sign declaration to secure AI supply chains
stories.summary: India, the U.S., and eight other nations have signed the San Francisco Declaration to treat AI supply chain security as a shared endeavor. The initiative, led by the U.S. Pax Silica project, aims to protect the minerals and silicon essential for semiconductor production and broader AI development.

stories.title: Signal restricts screenshots to counter AI surveillance
stories.summary: Signal is limiting screenshot capabilities within its app, citing the existential threat of OS-level AI agents that scan user screens. President Meredith Whittaker stated that integration of AI into Windows, Android, and iOS undermines the platform's ability to guarantee privacy by making sensitive data accessible to remote servers.

stories.title: UN fails to reach agreement on autonomous weapons
stories.summary: UN diplomats meeting in Geneva concluded a week of negotiations without establishing rules for autonomous weapons, often called killer robots. Representatives agreed only to start discussing options for future regulation. The International Committee of the Red Cross had previously called for legally binding rules within one year.

stories.title: London protesters demand stricter AI regulation
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered in London on Saturday to call for tighter AI regulation and a halt to the development of frontier models. Organized by the Pause AI UK group, the demonstration moved from the BBC office to Downing Street to voice concerns over the rapid development of the technology.

stories.title: House lawmakers launch AI Safety and Innovation Caucus
stories.summary: Twenty-nine House lawmakers have formed a bipartisan caucus to pursue AI safety legislation and briefings. Led by Representatives George Whitesides, Don Beyer, and Nathaniel Moran, the group intends to consult cybersecurity specialists and developers to create safeguards while maintaining U.S. leadership in the AI sector.

stories.title: London protesters march against unchecked AI development
stories.summary: Protesters marched through London on Saturday to demand stricter regulation of artificial intelligence. The demonstration highlighted public concern regarding the risks associated with rapid, unchecked development of AI systems. Participants carried signs warning of potential dangers posed by the technology as it continues to evolve.

stories.title: Signal blocks AI agents from reading user messages
stories.summary: Signal has updated its app to prevent AI assistants like Gemini and Siri from capturing screen data. The company stated that Google and Apple are integrating agentic capabilities deep into their operating systems, which necessitates these new protections to keep user messages from being read by AI tools.

stories.title: Expert warns of AI-driven cyber threats to Indian banks
stories.summary: Cybersecurity expert Krishna Sastry Pendyala warned that gaps in India's data protection framework could leave banks and supply chains vulnerable to AI-trained cyber attacks. Speaking at the India Data Protection Summit 2026, he noted that the country's rapid digitization has created a fertile ground for such threats.

stories.title: Chief Justice of India advocates for AI regulation over bans
stories.summary: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant stated that establishing clear rules for AI is preferable to a total embargo. Addressing a legal conference, he noted that generative AI has unsettled traditional assessment methods and suggested that law schools should require oral explanations to verify a student's actual knowledge.

research.title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern recommendation systems face substantial memory pressure, largely from the sparse embedding layer that maps high-cardinality categorical features into dense vectors. In-training embedding pruning (ITEP) removes less important embedding rows during training, yielding end-to-end memory savings. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
